description: Small early-stage fintech. No DPO. Weak encryption. Some consent gaps. No breach.
Had a confirmed data breach. Notification delayed past 72 hours. Otherwise reasonable controls.
Old systems. Encryption completely absent. Many processors without DPAs. Retention overdue.
High growth, lots of third-party sharing, cross-border transfers, minor customers without guardian consent.
Strong controls. Minor operational gaps only. No breach.
Ignores erasure requests. High SLA breach rate on DSARs.
Collects consent for loan processing but processes for marketing and analytics.
Employees with wrong roles accessing PII. Audit logs overdue.
Has internal policies but they are inactive or declare weak standards.
Multiple CRITICAL violations simultaneously: breach delay, children's data, encryption failure, erasure failure, retention.
Heavily international operations. Many transfers to unapproved countries. Most processors have no DPA.
Serves large proportion of minor customers. Guardian consent records mostly missing or expired.
Obtains consent but bundles it with T&Cs. Processing purposes mismatch consented purposes widely.
Purpose completed everywhere but nothing deleted. Retention violations across the board.
Payment processor integrated with many third parties. High sharing rate, many processors without DPAs.
DPO exists but audit is severely overdue. Access logs have missing outcome fields.
Previously non-compliant, now improving. Mostly fixed but some legacy gaps remain.
Digital-only bank. Poor role-based access controls. Bulk data access common. No grievance endpoint.
No grievance mechanism. No DPO. Audit severely overdue. Otherwise compliant in data handling.
Massive scale processing. Bulk access events. Several DSAR SLA breaches. Stale consent reuse.
Serves rural customers via branch and agent networks. High implicit consent usage. No digital infrastructure.
Heavy use of credit data with many third-party bureau integrations. Several DPA gaps on sub-processors.
Strong fraud detection pipeline. High PII access volume by analysts. Some purpose mismatch due to fraud reuse.
Embedded finance via partner APIs. Many sub-processors. High cross-border. Mixed encryption standards.
Extreme CRITICAL training example. Nearly every control has failed simultaneously. All CRITICAL rules fire.
